summary.text: Elizabeth Holmes is the Democratic candidate for the Florida House of Representatives, District 94, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A public school teacher with 15 years of experience, she is a lifelong Palm Beach County resident, according to her Ballotpedia survey.

paragraphs.text: Holmes graduated from Wellington High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Florida Atlantic University in 2010, according to Ballotpedia, and her listed profession is teacher.
In the survey, Holmes named the cost of living, public education and local decision-making among her key messages, and said she wants to keep data centers out of communities.
She listed education, insurance reform, local freedom and the environment as the policy areas she is most passionate about.
